      "Concept Name": "Watchdog enable setting",
      "Unit": "neorv32_wdt",

        "Integrity": "yes",

      "Objectives At Risk": [
        "I",
        "A"
      ],
      "Attack": "Issue an unlocked bus write that clears the enable bit, disabling watchdog servicing and the associated clock-enable output.",

        "bus_req_i.data"
      ],

        "bus_rsp_o.data",

        "Confidentiality": "no",
        "Integrity": "yes",
        "Availability": "yes",
        "Undermined Expected Behavior": "no"

A set lock blocks configuration use of the bus request and can cause a forced-reset path on later accesses, as shown at lines 93-100.",
      "Objectives At Risk": [
        "I",
        "A"
      ],
      "Attack": "Write the lock state or exploit its locked-access behavior to prevent required configuration changes or repeatedly trigger the access-reset path.",
      "Enters Through": [
        "bus_req_i.data"
      ],
      "Leaves Through": [
        "bus_rsp_o.data"

        "Confidentiality": "no",
        "Integrity": "yes",
        "Availability": "yes",
        "Undermined Expected Behavior": "no"

The threshold determines whether and when the timeout reset path reaches rstn_o through lines 144-161, so an attacker can withhold or prematurely cause system operation.",

        "I",
        "A"

      "Information": "The stored count and started state represent watchdog progress toward the configured timeout. Watchdog behavior depends on this internal state even though no port carries the count itself.",
      "Rubric": {
        "Confidentiality": "no",
        "Integrity": "yes",
        "Availability": "yes",
        "Undermined Expected Behavior": "no"

      "Rubric": {
        "Confidentiality": "no",
        "Integrity": "yes",
        "Availability": "yes",
        "Undermined Expected Behavior": "no"
      },
      "Rubric Reason": "The fixed-value comparison at line 102 selects the reset-wdt or reset-force actions at lines 103-105, so an incorrect match decision compromises authorization integrity.       "Rubric": {
        "Confidentiality": "no",
        "Integrity": "yes",
        "Availability": "no",
        "Undermined Expected Behavior": "no"
      },
      "Rubric Reason": "The reset-identifier process can change the cause state based on reset inputs and internal reset events at lines 168-177, and the result is exposed in the bus response at line 111, so unauthorized alteration can provide an incorrect reset diagnosis.",
      "Objectives At Risk": [
        "I"

      "Attack": "Induce or interfere with a reset-cause update so software reads a false explanation for the system reset.",
